words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 今天天气真好，晴空万里。(Jīntiān tiānqì zhēn hǎo, qíngkōng wànlǐ.) — The weather today is really great, completely clear skies.
你觉得这家餐馆怎么样？(Nǐ juéde zhè jiā cānguǎn zěnmeyàng?) — How do you like this restaurant?
夏天这里非常热。(Xiàtiān zhèlǐ fēicháng rè.) — In summer it is very hot here.
今天刮风，有点儿冷。(Jīntiān guāfēng, yǒudiǎnr lěng.) — It's windy today and a bit cold.
春天的下午很暖和。(Chūntiān de xiàwǔ hěn nuǎnhuo.) — Spring afternoons are warm and pleasant.
下过雨后天气很凉快。(Xià guò yǔ hòu tiānqì hěn liángkuai.) — After the rain the weather is pleasantly cool.
出门记得带伞，外面要下雨了。(Chūmén jìde dài sǎn, wàimiàn yào xiàyǔ le.) — Remember to bring an umbrella, it is going to rain outside.
冬天北方经常下雪。(Dōngtiān běifāng jīngcháng xiàxuě.) — It often snows in the north during winter.
明天是个晴天，适合去郊游。(Míngtiān shì gè qíngtiān, shìhé qù jiāoyóu.) — Tomorrow will be a sunny day, perfect for an outing.
今天一直是阴天，没有出太阳。(Jīntiān yìzhí shì yīntiān, méiyǒu chū tàiyáng.) — Today has been overcast all day, no sun came out.
外面正在刮大风。(Wàimiàn zhèngzài guā dà fēng.) — Strong wind is blowing outside.
太阳从东边升起来了。(Tàiyáng cóng dōngbian shēng qǐlái le.) — The sun rose from the east.
中秋节的月亮又圆又亮。(Zhōngqiūjié de yuèliang yòu yuán yòu liàng.) — The Mid-Autumn moon is both round and bright.
夜空中闪烁着无数的星星。(Yèkōng zhōng shǎnshuò zhe wúshù de xīngxing.) — Countless stars twinkle in the night sky.
春天百花盛开，景色非常美。(Chūntiān bǎihuā shèngkāi, jǐngsè fēicháng měi.) — In spring all flowers bloom and scenery is beautiful.
夏天大家喜欢去海边游泳。(Xiàtiān dàjiā xǐhuan qù hǎibiān yóuyǒng.) — In summer everyone likes going to the beach to swim.
北京的秋天是一年中最美的季节。(Běijīng de qiūtiān shì yì nián zhōng zuì měi de jìjié.) — Beijing's autumn is the prettiest season of the year.
冬天出门要戴帽子和围巾。(Dōngtiān chūmén yào dài màozi hé wéijīn.) — Wear a hat and scarf when going out in winter.
周末我们一起去爬山吧。(Zhōumò wǒmen yìqǐ qù pá shān ba.) — Let's go climb mountains together this weekend.
山上的泉水清澈甘甜。(Shān shang de quánshuǐ qīngchè gāntián.) — The mountain spring water is clear and sweet.
院子里种着两棵大树。(Yuànzi lǐ zhòng zhe liǎng kē dà shù.) — Two large trees are planted in the courtyard.
公园里的红花开得真鲜艳。(Gōngyuán lǐ de hóng huā kāi de zhēn xiānyàn.) — The red flowers in the park bloom vividly.
请不要踩踏草坪。(Qǐng bú yào cǎità cǎopíng.) — Please do not trample on the grass.
一条清清的小河穿过村庄。(Yì tiáo qīngqīng de xiǎo hé chuānguò cūnzhuāng.) — A clear small river flows through the village.
海边的日落景色非常迷人。(Hǎibiān de rìluò jǐngsè fēicháng mírén.) — The sunset view by the seaside is charming.
